catalog_matching.manual_review_rule: All catalog_taup_compatible and unresolved candidates remain pending until waveform cause review is completed.
catalog_matching.official_p_station_identity: network and station code; location/channel may differ between co-located seismic and strong-motion sensors

evidence_boundary.claim: Catalog association and a manual-review queue extend the continuous evidence; unresolved candidates are not false-alarm labels.

manual_review.claim_gate: No unresolved candidate may be called a false alarm until the exported review CSV is complete and independently audited.

miniSEED_decode.policy: whole-file decode first; on libmseed integrity failure bisect fixed-size records, quarantine only failing records, and represent them as explicit gaps

runtime.normalization: per-channel causal EWMA demean and scale; state resets on quality-invalid packets
runtime.recurrent_state_reset: reset on every contiguous quality-valid segment boundary
